finish_summary:
1. bulk_discount_percent(50) returns 5 instead of expected 10 – implementation uses wrong thresholds.
2. parse_coupon('save20') raises ValueError despite spec allowing case-insensitive matching – implementation does not normalize case.
3. Cart.items() returns quantity only, but specification expects a mapping name -> (unit_price, quantity). The test fails because item stored as quantity integer.
4. Cart.total(coupon='BADCODE') does not raise ValueError; the implementation ignores invalid coupon codes instead of rejecting them.
